forbidden: You need the accounting read permission to open this page.
read_only: Read only: your organization cannot write accounting entries.
fields.name: Name
accounts.title: Cash and bank accounts
accounts.description: Cash boxes and bank accounts of your organization with their balances.
accounts.form_description: The account uses your organization's currency.
accounts.currency_hint: The account is opened in your organization's currency.
accounts.inactive_hint: An inactive account takes no new entries; it is never deleted.
accounts.empty_description: Open a cash box or a bank account to record collections and payments.
cari.title: Cari accounts
cari.description: Balances with your parent organization, your dealers and your customers.
cari.empty_description: A cari account opens with the first order, collection or payment.
entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Ledger rows of your organization, newest first. Reversed rows are marked.
settlement.description_collection: Money received from the counterparty into a cash or bank account. It lowers their balance.
settlement.description_payment: Money paid to the counterparty from a cash or bank account. It lowers your debt.
settlement.no_accounts: Open an active cash or bank account first.
settlement.fx_hint: {{from}} is converted to {{to}} at today's rate; the rate is frozen on the entry.
opening.title: Book opening balance
opening.description: The balance the account had before the system. No income or expense (P&L) is written; it is booked once, void the entry to correct it.
opening.exists: This account already has an opening balance; void it first.
validation.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero with at most two decimals.
validation.account: Pick a cash or bank account.
toast.failed: The operation failed. Please try again.
read_only_dealer: Read only: the accounting module is off for your organization. You can view your cari account and statement and dispute entries, but you cannot write entries.
statement.title: Statement
statement.invalid_range: The end date cannot be before the start date.
statement.export_done: The file is ready and downloading.
statement.export_status.expired: The file has expired; export again.
disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.description: Disputes on entries posted by the parent organization. The parent resolves them with a reversal, a revision or a rejection.
disputes.waiting: The dispute is open; the parent organization will resolve it.
disputes.open_description: Explain what is wrong with this entry. Your parent organization reviews it and corrects it with a reversal or a revision, or rejects it.
disputes.reason_hint: e.g. The order was returned; the amount should be 1,200.00.
disputes.resolve.title: Resolve dispute
disputes.resolve.description: The resolution is final and is written to both ledgers.
disputes.resolve.reversal_hint: Reverses every open row of the source in both ledgers.
disputes.resolve.revision_hint: Reverses the rows and posts the corrected amount at the frozen rate.
disputes.resolve.reject_hint: Nothing is posted; a reason is required.
manual.title: Manual entry
manual.description: Books income, an expense or a cari charge in the active book.
validation.account_or_cari: Pick an account or a cari account.
void.title: Reverse entry
void.description: The ledger is append-only: a mirror row cancels this entry.
customer_cari.title: Open a customer cari
customer_cari.description: Search a customer you serve; an existing cari account opens as it is.
customer_cari.not_served: Your organization does not serve this customer.
